caption: The drawing features a reddish-brown pottery vessel with two large, symmetrical, curved handles attached near the top on opposite sides. The vessel has a rounded, bulbous body that narrows at the top before flaring out slightly at the rim. The rim is topped with four short cylindrical spouts positioned in a tight semi-circle, and the surface near the top is punctuated by two symmetrical rows of small holes. The body of the vessel is decorated with an incised design at the center, showing an eagle with outstretched wings above a shield, and a small oval-shaped cartouche above the eagle containing some illegible script. There are a few scattered lighter patches, indicating wear or exposure of the underlying material. The vessel sits against a plain, off-white background, and in the lower right corner, the artist's signature and date are visible in blue-green ink.
title: Jar
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
